name: Emerson Arcadia 2001
description: A compact cartridge console released by Emerson Radio in 1982, built around Signetics chips. It sold poorly in the US but was licensed and cloned widely, with over 30 variants sold around the world, including Bandai's Japanese version.
curiosities: It ran on a 12-volt supply, so it could be powered from a car or boat.
It launched in the US at $99.
It reached stores shortly before the ColecoVision.
Emerson reportedly built versions of Pac-Man, Galaxian and Defender for it but never shipped them, reportedly because of legal pressure from Atari.
